How it works

A specific read — then a fix you can actually wear.

Looktok looks at the same things a good stylist would, names them plainly, and pairs every note with a concrete change. Here's exactly what that means.

What it evaluates
01

Fit

Where the garment pulls, bunches or hangs — sleeve and hem breaks, shoulder seams, waist.

02

Proportion

How the pieces balance against your build — top-to-bottom ratio, where the eye lands.

03

Footwear

Whether the shoes carry the outfit or fight it — formality, colour, bulk.

04

Layering

What each layer adds, and where one is doing nothing but adding weight.

05

Colour temperature

Whether the palette holds together or one piece pulls warm against the rest.

Smart commerce

Not on a model. On you.

Looktok doesn't just suggest cuts and colours — every idea is rendered on your own photo, and the whole look adapts to how you're actually built. What you see is how it sits on you.

Your personal boutique

Love the look? Keep it.

Save the looks you love to your gallery, with the brand names as your shopping list for later. No storefront, no checkout — Looktok is about how you look, not what you're sold.

Your photo & privacy

Your photo is the whole product. We treat it that way.

This is a body-image-adjacent product, so we won't hand-wave this.

Private by default

Your photos and renders live in private storage, readable only from your account.

Used for one thing

The photo exists to produce your read and your renders. It's never sold or handed to advertisers.

Delete any time

Deleting a look deletes its files. Want everything gone? One email — the account and its data are erased.

See it on your own photo.

The read is only half of it — the better version is styled on you.
